reviews.author: Courtney Williams
reviews.text: Ethan and his team installed a new roof on our historic colonial home and did an amazing job! The crew worked through frigid temperatures and strong winds to accommodate our tight schedule and the roof turned out great. The entire team was professional, courteous, and punctual. Huge thanks to Matt (our project manager), Ethan, and the crew!

reviews.author: A.D. Williams
reviews.text: Ethan and his team were amazing! We had them install a brand new standing seam metal roof on our home along with removing several skylights that had been leaking. Ethan kept up great communication throughout the project and really worked to ensure we were comfortable throughout. The guys worked quickly and did a good job with cleanup, including leaving us some of the old roof for other projects we have planned. We are very happy with how it turned out and look forward to no longer having leaks during storms. They are extremely deserving of this 5 star review and I highly recommend them for your roofing needs.

reviews.author: Player Aston
reviews.text: Attention to Detail. It’s what I was looking for and it’s what I received with Ethan Richardson Roofing. After one phone call with Ethan I had a detailed quote and timeline for the project. Ethan kept me up to date with any delays (due to weather) and was on site for most of the process. I knew I had some problem areas with rotten wood and fragile siding but the crew removed and replaced what was needed and found solutions to other issues. There was no time wasted once the project began and they cleaned up after themselves afterwards. I inspected the roof and work multiple times throughout the process and was pleased with everything I saw. I recommend Ethan Richardson and his crew to anyone.

reviews.author: Jack Boyd
reviews.text: Outstanding company and people! We thought we needed a new roof and searched for companies for bids. Matt and Ethan were easy to work with. They were the only company that told us we might be able to get another year or so out of the current roof! They were not the lowest price, but you get what you pay for. We chose them because of the customer service they provided. Never once did I not get in touch with them immediately. They answer the phone! Their crew was amazing..roofing is a hard business and they worked non stop in 90 degrees. They left our property as they found it. Thanks to Ethan, Matt and the crew!

reviews.author: Chuck Mckenzie
reviews.text: All the guys at ethan Richardson roofing are top notch. Easy and quick process from start to finish. Definitely recommend for all your roofing needs.

reviews.author: T collins
reviews.text: Ethan Richardson roofing LLC was great. Professional work done in a timely manner. Very cost efficient. Would definitely call them again

reviews.author: Pam Cutler
reviews.text: We want to say thank you to Ethan Richardson and his team for our new roof! Our roof was in really bad shape and they worked wonders on it! Installing a new roof that was in as bad of shape as ours can create a hot mess but, Ethan's guys cleaned every last bit of it! I highly recommend Ethan and his team. Ethan was quick in responding to my many text messages. He and his guys were quick in getting the job done and very respectful! Thank you again, Ethan!

reviews.author: wapsharethis
reviews.text: Ethan and his crew are 1st class all the way. Great communication , fair pricing , excellent quality of work and an unbelievable clean up. Would you believe I had a rip off and replace and I didn't find one single nail left in my yard, thats amazing. Excellent work E.R.R. would class start to finish. When looking for a new roof definitely let him quote and walk the job with you.

reviews.author: Becky Pate
reviews.text: Could not ask for a better experience, from the initial contact to completion everything was great. His crew is the best, completed the job in one day and cleaned up behind themself’s where you could not tell they were even there AAAAAAA+++++++

reviews.author: Dominique Phillips
reviews.text: Matt N. was extremely helpful! I needed someone to come out and check a leak in my roof. He arrived within a couple hours. He inspected my roof and discovered, after going up into my attic, that my problem was actually a leaky pipe. Even after discovering that I needed help from a plumber, he went out of his way to take videos of the leak for me to relay to the plumber and he placed a pan under the pipe to help prevent further leaking/damage. He was very kind and considerate. Great customer service! I appreciate him going above and beyond to help me and I highly recommend his services!

reviews.author: Paul Cannarella
reviews.text: Thank you to you, Travis and your crew, you'll did a great job roofing my home. Your crew were professional, courteous and did an excellent job. I appreciated the clean up that was done at the end of the job as well. I would highly recommend Ethan Richardson Roofing LLC for any of your roofing repairs, and or replacements.

reviews.author: Ryan Berry
reviews.text: Ethan Richardson roofing reshingled the roofs at out DYB Kiwanis ballpark in Dillon, SC a few months ago. He did our concession, garage, press box, ticket booth, pump house, and field chalk box. His price was more than $500 less than the other two quotes. The quality of work was top notch. They showed up that morning and was done by 5pm that afternoon. Roofs look great and the area was left clean. Use Ethan Richardson roofing for all your roofing needs. Great people and excellent work!

reviews.author: Regina Martin
reviews.text: I was reluctant to use these guys because their estimate was slight higher than the other companies but I am so glad I did. They were very professional and time efficient. Done everything on the time line they gave me and what I am most happy with is when they were done I was left with a beautiful metal roof and absolutely nothing left behind. Ethan your crew was amazing and I really appreciate the pride they portrayed in their work.

reviews.author: Patsy King
reviews.text: Want to give a giant shout out to Ethan Richardson for amazing job they did on my roof. Very polite and extremely friendly group of men. Ethan kept me informed through the whole process. If anyone is needing a new roof or any roof repairs, Ethan Richardson Roofing are the ones to call They are on point and back their job. Call him, you won’t go wrong. Thank you so very much Ethan and your group.

reviews.author: Jordan King
reviews.text: Ethan Richardson Roofing was great to work with. Ethan replaced the roof on my commercial rehab facility within one week of him giving the quote. You cannot ask for a better company to do your roof.

reviews.author: Gregg Bussell
reviews.text: Our chimney was leaking. Travis was at our house the day I called and could find no "real" problem. We agreed that the water had been blown into the chimney. However, Travis did suggest that we calk some openings in the bricks and around the base of the chimney just to be sure. He returned a few days later to complete the work and even fixed some loose roof tile nails and spray painted our chimney cover. Finally, he suggested an excellent local person to do our small amount of gutter work. It is wonderful to work with such a knowledgeable and honest person as Travis. You will not find anyone better. By the way, our chimney does not leak anymore.

reviews.author: Deborah Anderson
reviews.text: Travis was very responsive and helpful in diagnosing and repairing a leak in my roof. He came out about two hours after I placed my initial phone call. He was very pleasant and explained what had caused the leak and he provided a much needed quick and economical solution.

reviews.author: Allyson English
reviews.text: I am very thankful for Ethan Richardson and his teams help and just want to make sure people know about his business. With so many people out there looking for a quick buck, it's wonderful to know there are still people out there, like Ethan and his crew, that are more about quality work and not just about making money!

reviews.author: Jessica Johnson
reviews.text: Great work! Went above and beyond to help us patch our roof before a storm. Came back after storm and repaired and shingled the entire roof. Great crew! Fast and reliable service!

reviews.author: Sean Lane
reviews.text: Ethan Richardson and his crew will make sure your house is done right and make sure your are happy before they leave. Great Company and will stand behind their work!!!

reviews.author: Marcella Mitchell
reviews.text: Awesome Experience!! Travis was a fabulous person to deal with from being to end! The team came worked and cleaned up every inch same day! Neighbors were amazed at the job! Definitely recommend! Thank you ERR Team!! Appreciate the experience!

reviews.author: Shamra Richardson
reviews.text: Called ERR to have roof checked for leak.Responded within a few days and met with Travis. Repaired leak and gave courtesy inspection of entire roof.After inspection we decided to replace roof. Replacement was done in a timely and professional manner. Yard was clean and all debris removed. Highly recommend ERR. Calvin Richardson

reviews.author: Joel Rivers
reviews.text: The personalized experience was the IT factor for me. Ethan takes the time to reach out to his customers throughout and after completion. Humility, customer care, and quality work come standard with ERR.

reviews.author: Corey Humphrey
reviews.text: Ethan and his crew replaced our roof and even replaced some boards over 5 years ago. Had a small issue in one spot 5 years later and they came out and repaired it and didn't charge me anything. I would recommend them any day. Thank you Ethan Travis and crew for everything.

reviews.author: Cheryl Hays
reviews.text: ERR replaced my 10 yo metal roof with a new metal roof. Looks amazing! BUT, took QUITE awhile once roofing was delivered. And the cost went up significantly between the estimate and install. Most annoyingly, I have NEVER been able to receive a return call. For ANY reason I have called... materials they left behind, a suspected leak, and now another repair issue, and it has been just under a year from the (really fast, which was nice) install. Finished product looks fantastic, but little to no customer service, and that's important! So the owner left a message here to contact him. I did. He and his foreman. Dates were made for him to drop by and make this simple repair. No show, no call. Now I cannot get any call back. And the worst part is, if I attempt to repair it myself, it will VOID my warranty. Which they know of course. Now I have to go to the trouble of filing a complaint...for a simple and quick fix on a NEW roof! SMH!

reviews.author: Kyle Meyer
reviews.text: Don’t go calling these out of town roofers that when your roof is leaking in three months from now,and they have your money but forgot who you are. Call Ethan Richardson Roofing today and get it right the first time with somebody that you’ll see in Walmart or Chruch and he knows he’s gonna do a good job because he’s gonna have to look you in the face. ￼ Ethan takes extreme pride in his work and his business. So much so he put his name on it.

reviews.author: Ivy Pope
reviews.text: If you have any roof problems…. You need to Contact Richardson Roofing- Ethan Richardson is your man!! They are prompt and professional and economical!!! You will not be disappointed!!

reviews.author: Tyler Porter
reviews.text: We had a leak in the roof of our business and gave Ethan a call. He came to check things out in a very timely manner. After they were finished fixing some minor issues we tried to pay and they would not accept! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

reviews.author: SyleenaDiva Walden
reviews.text: This crew of about a dozen men have been working on my HOA property for over a month and I never hear them!! They NEVER leave trash and debris! Thank God!! You would never think 2 buildings are being worked on simultaneously!! I work from home yet I still don't hear them! They are efficient because I've seen them start and finish an 8 unit dwelling in 1 day!! And it looks amazing! They are not even working on my house but stopped what they were doing just to help me load something into my car!! God-fearing, . professional, generous, and kind!! So glad my HOA hired them!! Thanks guys!! You are the best!!!

reviews.author: Gary Huttner (Eddy)
reviews.text: ERR came and repaired a leak on my metal roof, very professional, and straight forward , no high pressure sales pitch, no scare tactics .Did a great job . I will not hesitate to use them again in the future . Would recommend them to anyone needing roof work.

reviews.author: Joshua Rice
reviews.text: I don’t know about your roofs but who ever was driving in cayce today at 620 towards the airport doesn’t need to be driving a truck with your company’s name on it. Giving you a bad look everywhere they drive I promise you.

reviews.author: Liyah Hood
reviews.text: Ethan and his crew are so awesome at what they do!! They are also very quick at it as well!! We are so happy we went with Ethan Richardson Roofing!!

reviews.author: shari bethea
reviews.text: I called and believe me I was desperate for help with my roof . They were there within 2 hours and repaired it . Price was fair and they were very professional. Ethan Richardson has a great system and team work ..

reviews.author: Christopher s
reviews.text: Initial service was prompt and looked good (30 year GAF shingle) 5 years later I am working on not my first, not my second, but my third leak. Each time I have reached out for a warranty claim or to have a repair made and no one has showed. The last two attempts no one has even responded. If you like spending big money and still having hassles, this is the team for the job!

reviews.author: Patricia Thomas
reviews.text: ERR came out and accessed my roof. Got the insurance on board and put my roof on and I couldn't be happier. They did a great job from start to finish. I recommend them for any roofing needs.

reviews.author: Lee Hardee
reviews.text: Excellent service and extremely fast installation. Very thorough cleanup after the job was completed. Highly recommend for your roofing needs!

reviews.author: Jed Rowell
reviews.text: They came right after hurricane Florence. It wasn’t three days after our power came back in and replaced my whole roof. Did a jam up job and was gone in a day. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Betty Ellis
reviews.text: I Experienced Exactly Service With The Roofing Company , They Was On Time, The Roof Is Perfect, I Couldn't Fine A Better Company , The Staffs Was Great!!! I Just Need Someone To Painter THE Trimmer Around The House!!!!

reviews.author: Brett Cusaac
reviews.text: Travis was a pleasure to work with! Fast professional service and everything documented with pictures could not ask for a better roofer!

reviews.author: Lauren DiCesare
reviews.text: You couldn't ask for a more professional, good hearted, trustworthy company. They go above and beyond what is expected and make sure that the customer is over the moon with the results. Highly, highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Mike Thompson
reviews.text: Awesome crew! Neat, professional, answered questions or concerns instantly, and everything was done in a timely manner from the first call to the completion of the job.

reviews.author: John Eddy
reviews.text: Workers need to be aware that when they are in a vehicle with the business branding on it, their actions reflect on the business. 65+ in a 45 and recklessly passing multiple vehicles in a single pass.

reviews.author: Jennifer Massey
reviews.text: Called and got same day service when four other companies were no call no shows. Great to work with.

reviews.author: J. Inglesby
reviews.text: We called for an estimate and decided to use them because they were very fair with the price of doing our roof and super friendly. They made everything extremely easy! They got the job done way faster than I expected and they make sure your happy with everything by checking up with you. If you need someone trust worthy, fast, and knowledgeable, definitely give them a try! We highly recommend them!

reviews.author: YewDewTew BTW
reviews.text: Travis showed up when he was scheduled to. He completed a roofing inspection, along with roofing repairs. He did a great job, was very friendly. Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Kim Driggers
reviews.text: ERR done an outstanding job roofing a 75 year old home I'm remodeling that belonged to my great grandparents. Very quick response time and best all-around professional service! Highly recommended!!!
